definitions.gloss: soft quality; soft type (of a material)
definitions.explanation: A soft or pliable physical quality of a material, used attributively to classify a substance as the soft variety. The opposite of {硬質|こうしつ} (hard quality).

examples.japanese: {軟質|なんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軟質|なんしつ}⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This case is made of a soft material.

examples.japanese: {軟質|なんしつ}⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{硬質|こうしつ}→硬質：16910_koushitsu⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧しやすい。
examples.english: Soft glass is easier to work than hard glass.

notes:
Used almost exclusively as a modifier classifying a material by hardness, especially for plastics, glass, and similar substances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軟質|なんしつ}⟦プラスチック→プラスチック：00347_purasuchikku⟧: soft plastic
- {軟質|なんしつ}⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧: soft glass
- {軟質|なんしつ}⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: soft material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{硬質|こうしつ}→硬質：16910_koushitsu⟧: hard quality — the direct antonym.
